name: COMP_032
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (58%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Benign · Careful review
The 90% conformal set includes Benign (37%) [F1], and simulated frozen-section margins flag inferior and medial involvement [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 58%, Benign 37%, Normal 4%, Invasive 0% | Favors InSitu over Benign; non-invasive |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% dataset coverage, 10% alpha) | Cannot separate InSitu from Benign |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 74th OOD percentile, 12/12 tiles [F6] | Typical input; passes quality check |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent backbones match top call |
| Similar cases | 3/5 InSitu, 2/5 Normal (60% agreement) [F5] | Mixed; closest neighbor is Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 6, 8, 10) · ↓ invasive · Strongest anti-invasion score (-0.75), but failed AI spot-check (0/20) [F2] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 0, 1) · context · Elevated stromal lymphocyte score (-0.69); borderline AI spot-check (8/20) [F3] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 1, 5, 9) · ↓ invasive · Intraductal atypia score (-0.40) opposes invasion; 12/20 spot-check [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 4, 6, 8) · ↓ invasive · Background stroma score (-0.35) opposes invasion; 20/20 AI spot-check · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Mild pro-invasion score (+0.34); 19/20 AI spot-check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top-3 risk regions lowers invasive score more than random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Ductal atypia in regions 1, 5, 9 is benign or normal, matching top neighbor BACH_0010 (Normal, 92% similarity).
- Simulated frozen-section artifacts mask focal invasion in region 8 (12% risk) or unsampled deeper tissue (reliability AUROC 70%).

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 8**: Highest invasive risk (12%) and positive inferior/medial margin call (108 um each); rule out invasion.
2. **Regions 1, 5, 9**: Assess intraductal atypia versus benign hyperplasia; consider the drafted deeper levels order.
3. **Regions 0, 1, 7**: Inspect region 7 for stromal invasion and regions 0, 1 for pleomorphism and TILs.
